car_accelerator.script: When you press the gas pedal, your car speeds up. That’s force!

pushing_bed.script: If your bed won’t move, you need more force—like pushing harder.

light_switch.script: A qubit is like a light switch that can be *both* on and off at once!

energy.abstract: The capacity to do work (Conserved quantity)

battery_life.script: Energy is like your phone's battery percentage—it determines how much 'work' the device can do.
battery_life.user_check: Do you monitor your phone battery? (yes/no)

hill_climb.script: Cycling up a hill gives you potential energy. Rolling down converts it to kinetic energy.
hill_climb.user_check: Have you ever ridden a bike up a hill? (yes/no)

momentum.abstract: The quantity of motion (p=mv), conserved in isolated systems.

freight_train.script: A heavy train is hard to stop even at slow speeds because it has huge momentum.
freight_train.user_check: Have you ever seen a train stopping? (yes/no)
